# Tools

A Cowork Agent is born knowing how to work inside Ronin. It gets two kinds of help at
birth: **tools** it can run, and **behaviours** that guide how it works.

## Tools

Tools do jobs and report what happened. A Cowork Agent is told:

<!-- tool-list: generated by scripts/tool-list.mjs from ronin_stock/tools; do not edit -->
- `edges`: message an Agent, post to the Team's wipeboard, read another session
- `work-record`: keep your objective, repos and documents true
- `session_*`: check, create, change, archive, restore and end Agent sessions; `session_create` rides Recruit: staff agents
- `plan`: list, read, write, park and order the Workspace's plans
- `canvas`: list the canvas templates; make, read and edit the Workspace's canvases (read shows each live block as it is now)
- `item`: create, find, move, hand off and comment on work items; check out library items
- `worktree-desk`: open, sync and hand in your worktree
- `machine-settings`: read or change Campaign defaults, providers and Workspace folders
- `team`: create or read a Team's roster and what it holds
- `ronin-host`: measure the machine: what it is, its space, its account, which secrets exist
- `office`: the machine status, the one complete truth: what this office has set up, what it hasn't and what is available; hosted, its `account` fact is the person's Business Lounge record
- `workspace-doc`: read and write the office's Workspace docs: each Workspace's Summary and notes
- `mika`: ask Mika, Ronin's help assistant
- `lookup`: print a Ronin document by its `mika-source:` id
- `show`: open a Ronin page in another visible workspace of the owner's tab, never the one they are on
- `owner_view`: what the owner is looking at in a browser tab
- `ready`: mark that you are about to speak to the person; a chat that honours it shows only what follows
- `secret`: get a password or key from the owner without it passing through chat
- `netlify`: Netlify sites, deploys, previews, traffic, forms and variables for the Workspace's site
- `mcp`: list the MCP servers available to your Campaign, fetch one's tools, call one
- `preview`: find a pull request's preview link and put it in your Documents
- `api`: list the web APIs available to your Campaign, call one with Ronin holding its key
- `ronin-help`: the longer document on a topic, or a Ronin word
<!-- /tool-list -->

The provider's own tools (reading files, running commands, searching) are there too;
Ronin adds to them and takes nothing away.

## Handing an Agent a secret

When an Agent needs a password or key (a KVM login, an API token), it never needs to see it
in chat, and you never paste it into a message.

- **The Agent asks:** `secret ask <name> --for "<what it is>"`. A paste field opens at the foot
  of its tile, where the message box sits, in Chat and in Terminal: the conversation or terminal
  above stays readable and scrollable, so the Agent's instructions stay in view while you paste.
  Click into it, paste, and press **Save**, or **Cancel** (Escape in the field cancels too).
  Beside the value is **Expires**, one choice of four: **Nothing** (the default: not known),
  **A date** (a date picker), **Never** (it does not expire, recorded as such), or **In N days**
  (a number of days from today, with 30, 90 and 180 as quick picks; it is saved as the date it
  lands on). Choosing Nothing again clears whatever was picked.
  Save says *Saving…*, then *Saved* shows for a moment before the field closes; if the save is
  refused, it stays open and says why. The Agent hears
  only `saved: <name>` or `cancelled: <name>`.
- **The Agent uses it by its file:** `secret path <name>` prints where it is, to pass as
  `--password-file` or read in its own script. `secret ls` lists the names, with
  `expires <date>` or `never expires` beside each that has one, and nothing beside the rest.
- **An expiry for one already saved:** `secret expires <name> <YYYY-MM-DD|<N>d|never|clear>`
  sets it without re-pasting (`90d` is 90 days from today); `clear` makes it not known again.
  Only the expiry changes.

Each secret is one file in `~/ronin/services_secrets`, readable only by you. Expiry dates are kept
beside them in `secrets-expiry.json`, never inside a value file. Ronin never
prints a value, and no reply, log or chat carries one. A name is lowercase letters, digits,
`_` and `-`.

## Behaviours

Behaviours are short written guidance: how to plan, how to work in a Team, when to write
things down. Some reach every Cowork Agent;
some come with a role, a desk or an integration; others you add when you start an Agent, or
for a Campaign, Workspace or Team. They guide; they do not lock anything.

## Mandate

Each Agent also gets a **mandate**: how far it goes before it checks in (Reach), whether
it may bring in more Agents (Recruit), and what it hands back (Output). You set it on the
New Agent form.
